research_basis: Parking-slot pipelines commonly derive slots from segmented linear markings, then skeleton/Hough/line arrangement.
Inverse-perspective or top-view reasoning helps geometry, but local test showed rectification does not make generic inpainting sufficient.

layers.rule: Fit one smooth lot-wide field from known asphalt pixels only; do not blur through cars before masking.
layers.acceptance: No former-car-shaped or broad rectangular brightness bands at iPhone scale.

layers.rule: Sample high-frequency residual from multiple valid MASTER asphalt donors; exclude vehicle, tutorial and paint pixels; deterministic non-periodic placement.
layers.acceptance: No repeated-tile pattern or colored vehicle ghosts.

layers.rule: Detect visible parking markings, fit line/grid structure, restore missing segments as dedicated geometry.
layers.acceptance: Parking dividers remain coherent across formerly occluded areas; EXIT and non-parking markings remain faithful.

hard_invariants: direct full-resolution visual QA before promotion
next_atomic_action: Build marking/lot structure analyzer and persist machine-readable line/grid model before any new clean-plate pixels are promoted.
